name: council
description: claude.ai chat edition. Convene a council of independent Claude subagents on a hard decision. Each seat answers blind in its own subagent, the seats then peer-review each other anonymously and vote on every claim, a script tallies the votes, and the main session chairs a synthesis that keeps dissent visible. Returns a verdict, a consensus and dissent table, the strongest dissent worth weighing, and a confidence rating. Use ONLY when the user explicitly asks for it - /council, "council this", "as
